meta.title: Win-Pilot Computer Use
meta.description: Operate Windows applications and Win-Pilot-owned Chromium sessions, optionally inside an isolated task desktop that keeps your own windows untouched.

en.desktopHint: Applies to the next computer operation, including this chat. Observe new targets after switching. Complete Windows feature setup and local sign-in once; remember, update or clear sign-in in the task window.
en.fieldBrowserHeadlessDefault: Run in background without a window
en.fieldStatusPill: Show the status pill while an action runs
en.hintHeadless: Run browsers in the background with no window and no taskbar entry. Turn off to watch the browser.
en.hintOverlay: Draw a cursor that follows the AI while it works, so you can see what it is doing.
en.hintStatusPill: Show a status pill at the top of the screen while an action runs; it hides itself when finished.
en.intro: Appearance and browser preferences take effect on save. Unset options keep their defaults.
en.reloadFailed: Reload failed. Check runtime status or restart DSH.
en.restartRequired: Restart DSH to activate this update
en.title: Win-Pilot Computer Use
en.unavailable: Editable settings for this plugin are unavailable. Check that the plugin is enabled and reopen its settings page.
